# MLX-VLM
## Video Understanding
[Permalink: Video Understanding](https://github.com/Blaizzy/mlx-vlm#video-understanding)

MLX-VLM also supports video analysis such as captioning, summarization, and more, with select models.

### Supported Models
1. Qwen2-VL
2. Qwen2.5-VL
3. Idefics3
4. LLaVA
5. MiniMax M3
6. LLaVA-OneVision
7. Mage-VL

With more coming soon.

### Usage Examples
